title: Radio waves
kid: The access point turns each parcel into ones and zeros and sends them through the air on an invisible radio wave. Big wiggles mean 1, small wiggles mean 0!
nerd: Bits modulate a 2.4/5/6 GHz carrier. Shown here as simple amplitude-shift keying; real Wi-Fi uses OFDM with up to 4096-QAM, packing 12 bits into every symbol on hundreds of sub-carriers.
